title: AI LLM Price Router & Budget Calculator Input

action.title: Tool Action
action.description: Select which routing or budget tool to run.

task_type.title: Task Type (for recommend_cheapest_model)
task_type.description: Workload profile: coding, reasoning, general, multimodal, cheap, or free.

min_context.title: Minimum Context Window
min_context.description: Minimum required context length in tokens.

region_preference.title: Region / Channel Preference
region_preference.description: Filter by 'cn_direct' (Mainland China RMB), 'global' (OpenRouter USD), or 'any'.

monthly_input_m.title: Monthly Input Tokens (Millions)
monthly_input_m.description: Estimated monthly input tokens in millions.

monthly_output_m.title: Monthly Output Tokens (Millions)
monthly_output_m.description: Estimated monthly output tokens in millions.

model_query.title: Model Query (for calculate_api_budget)
model_query.description: Model ID or keyword (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4', 'deepseek-v3', 'qwen3', or 'auto' when passing a multi-model CSV bill in usage_snippet).

avg_input_tokens.title: Avg Input Tokens per Request
avg_input_tokens.description: Average input prompt tokens per request.

cache_hit_rate.title: Prompt Cache Hit Rate (0.0 - 0.9)
cache_hit_rate.description: Fraction of input tokens hitting prompt cache (e.g. 0.5 for 50% hit rate).

usage_mode.title: Usage Mode
usage_mode.description: Choose 'interactive_ide' (Cursor/Claude Code/Cline) or 'automated_backend' (excludes personal Coding Plans).

peak_5h_calls.title: Optional Peak 5-Hour Calls
peak_5h_calls.description: Optional peak API calls within a rolling 5-hour window to verify 1,200/6,000 hard caps.

team_size.title: Developer Seats (team_size, 1-50)
team_size.description: Number of interactive IDE developer seats (1..50). Compares N compliant Coding Plan seats against a shared team Pay-As-You-Go API pool.

monthly_requests.title: Optional Monthly Total Requests (for calculate_api_budget)
monthly_requests.description: Optional total API requests per month from a cloud billing statement (overrides daily_requests when set).

cached_input_m.title: Optional Monthly Cached Input Tokens (Millions)
cached_input_m.description: Optional monthly cached input tokens in millions to compute exact cache_hit_rate.

usage_snippet.title: Optional Multi-Model CSV/JSONL Bill / Raw Usage Log / JSON Snippet
usage_snippet.description: Paste an OpenRouter Activity CSV, cloud console CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL bill (incl. Claude Code `.jsonl` & OpenAI Batch `.jsonl`), Claude Code `/cost` output, `usage` JSON, or cloud console summary to auto-parse usage and generate `bill_audit` + `migration_litellm_config`.

days_observed.title: Observation Window in Days (for usage_snippet)
days_observed.description: Number of days covered by usage_snippet (default 30).

refresh_live.title: Refresh Live OpenRouter Data First
refresh_live.description: Fetch fresh pricing from OpenRouter before answering.
